???+ remember "Before you start, remember"

    ??? question "What is a cover, and how does macro expansion fit the definition?"

        A cover is a set of tiles, tree patterns paired with an instruction and a cost, in which every node of the tree belongs to exactly one tile; macro expansion is the cover made only of one-node tiles.

        Introduced in [C. The classical pipeline: C1. Instruction selection](c1-instruction-selection.md).

    ??? question "Which agreement between caller and callee says where arguments are placed and where the return value is found?"

        The calling convention.

        Introduced in [Build v0.1: 7. Functions and control flow](../compiler/guide/stage-7-functions-and-control-flow.md).

    ??? question "Why does a back end built purely from macro expansion need no register allocator?"

        Every value lives in its own stack slot and no value stays in a register past its own template, so no two values ever compete for a register and nothing needs saving around a call except the return address.

        Introduced in [B. A first native back end: B1. The simplest back end that works](b1-simplest-backend.md).
